Technical Data Dictionary: Input Files & Databases

Technical_reference.Rmd

Overview & Architecture

herdr operates on a structured, file-based data engine. All project data is separated into two categories:

  1. User Input Tables (user_data/): CSV templates that you create or edit to describe your specific livestock scenario.
  2. Reference Libraries: Package-bundled reference databases (.csv and .parquet) providing official IPCC coefficients, nutritional tables (FEDNA), crop productivities (FAOSTAT / MAPA), bilateral trade flows, and feed life cycle inventories (ECOALIM v9 / AGRIBALYSE v3.1).
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                          PRIMARY DEMOGRAPHIC COHORT KEYS                               │
├─────────────────┬─────────────────────────┬──────────────┬─────────────────────────────┤
│  farm_id        │  animal_tag             │  region      │  subregion                  │
│  (Mandatory)    │  (Mandatory)            │  (Optional)  │  (Optional)                 │
│  e.g., "farm_1" │  e.g., "dairy_cows"     │  e.g., spain │  e.g., "north"              │
└─────────────────┴─────────────────────────┴──────────────┴─────────────────────────────┘

⚠️ Critical Rules on Identifiers & Ordering: 1. All table joins rely on exact string matching across the four demographic keys (farm_id, animal_tag, region, subregion). Identifiers are strictly lowercase and use underscores instead of spaces (e.g., mature_dairy_cattle, NOT Mature Dairy Cattle). 2. The row order in livestock_census.csv defines the exact top-to-bottom order of cohorts in all output tables (totals and intensities) and plots (plot_herdr_results()).

I. User Input Schema (user_data/)

1. Herd Census (livestock_census.csv)

Declares the standing population count for each animal group and establishes the display order across outputs.

Column Type Unit Required? Description & Valid Values
farm_id character — Yes Farm or enterprise holding identifier (e.g., farm_1, farm_north).
animal_tag character — Yes Primary cohort identifier (e.g., mature_dairy_cattle, fattening_pigs).
region character — No Broad geographic stratum or country (e.g., spain).
subregion character — No Administrative province, autonomous community, or regional sub-unit (e.g., north, south).
population numeric head Yes Annual Average Population (AAP) of live animals present on farm.

2. Body Weights & Biological Cycles (livestock_weights.csv)

Defines the weight boundaries and life cycle durations used for maintenance energy, growth, and throughput modeling.

Column Type Unit Required? Description & Valid Values
farm_id, animal_tag, region, subregion character — Yes Demographic keys matching livestock_census.csv.
adult_weight_kg numeric kg Yes Average mature live weight of an adult animal of this breed/species.
productive_period_days numeric days Yes Life cycle or biological interval:
• Breeding females (cows, sows, ewes, does): Inter-parturition interval (e.g. 365 d for cows, 149 d for sows).
• Laying hens: Commercial laying cycle duration (e.g. 511 d).
• Growing/fattening stock: Life cycle / days on feed (e.g. 42 d for broilers, 110 d for pigs).
initial_weight_kg numeric kg Yes Live body weight at the start of this specific production phase.
final_weight_kg numeric kg Yes Live body weight at the end of this phase (e.g. slaughter weight).
sows_gestation_days numeric days Swine Gestation duration for breeding sows (default: 115 days).
sows_lactation_days numeric days Swine Lactation duration for breeding sows (default: 28 days).
piglet_birth_weight_kg numeric kg Swine Average live weight of newborn piglet (default: 1.4 kg).
piglet_weaning_weight_kg numeric kg Swine Average live weight of piglet at weaning (default: 6.5 kg).
sow_reserve_gain_kg numeric kg Swine Net maternal tissue reserve recovery during gestation (default: 15.0 kg).

3. Ruminant Definitions (ruminant_definitions.csv)

Links ruminant cohorts to IPCC Tier 2 metabolic equations, milk yields, and reproductive traits.

Column Type Unit Required? Description & Valid Values
farm_id, animal_tag, region, subregion character — Yes Demographic keys matching livestock_census.csv.
animal_type character — Yes Broad species (strict): cattle, sheep, or goat.
animal_subtype character — Yes Production target (strict): dairy or meat.
production_role character — Yes Functional lifecycle role (strict): mature, replacement, or slaughter.
diet_tag character — Yes Ration identifier matching diet_profiles.csv.
cfi character — Yes Maintenance coefficient descriptor matching ipcc_coefficients.csv.
ca character — Yes Feeding activity coefficient descriptor matching ipcc_coefficients.csv.
c character — Cattle Growth coefficient category for cattle (females, castrates, bulls).
a, b character — Sheep/Goat Growth constants a and b for sheep and goats matching ipcc_coefficients.csv.
milk_yield_kg_year numeric kg/head/yr Dairy Annual average fresh milk yield per cow/ewe/doe.
fat_content_pct numeric % Dairy Milk fat content percentage (e.g. 3.8).
protein_content_pct numeric % Dairy Milk crude protein percentage (e.g. 3.4). If left blank or 0, estimated via IPCC fat regression.
wool_yield_kg_year numeric kg/head/yr Sheep Annual greasy wool shorn per head (e.g. 3.0).
work_hours numeric h/day Working Daily hours worked by draft animals (default: 0).
pr_sheep_goat numeric kids/litter Sheep/Goats Prolificacy: average kids or lambs born per litter (e.g. 1.5).
c_pregnancy_cattle character — Cattle Pregnancy coefficient descriptor matching ipcc_coefficients.csv.
pregnancy_rate numeric 0.0–1.0 Cattle Annual calving or pregnancy rate (e.g. 0.90 for 90%).
replacement_rate numeric 0.0–1.0 Breeding Annual replacement or culling fraction (e.g. 0.27 for 27% replacement). Used in demographic closure and adult meat culling.

4. Monogastric Definitions (monogastric_definitions.csv)

Configures swine and poultry cohorts following FEDNA and MAPA nutritional standards.

Column Type Unit Required? Description & Valid Values
farm_id, animal_tag, region, subregion character — Yes Demographic keys matching livestock_census.csv.
animal_type character — Yes Broad species (strict): swine or poultry.
animal_subtype character — Yes Subtype (strict): meat for swine; meat or layer for poultry.
production_role character — Yes Functional lifecycle role (strict): mature, replacement, or slaughter.
diet_tag character — Yes Ration identifier matching diet_profiles.csv.
cfi_maintenance numeric kcal/kg^alpha Yes Daily metabolizable energy maintenance requirement (e.g. 104.5–206 for swine, 113–131 for poultry).
frac_fat_pct numeric fraction Monogastric Fraction of live weight gain deposited as fat tissue (e.g. 0.266).
frac_protein_pct numeric fraction Monogastric Fraction of live weight gain deposited as protein tissue (e.g. 0.153).
eggs_per_year numeric eggs/hen/yr Poultry Annual egg production per hen (e.g. 297–314 for layers, 211.7 for meat breeders).
egg_weight_g numeric g/egg Poultry Average weight of one fresh egg (e.g. 60–64).
fertility_rate numeric 0.0–1.0 Breeders Hatching / fertility success rate in breeder flocks (e.g. 0.83).
alpha numeric — Swine Metabolic weight exponent (e.g. 0.60 for growing pigs, 0.75 for adult sows/boars; fixed at 0.75 for poultry).
piglets_born numeric piglets/litter Swine Sows Total piglets born per farrowing (e.g. 16.26).
piglets_suckling numeric piglets/litter Swine Sows Piglets weaned per farrowing litter (e.g. 13.05).
replacement_rate numeric 0.0–1.5 Breeding Annual replacement or culling fraction (e.g. 0.25 for sows, 0.714 for layers, 1.2126 for meat breeders).

5. Diet Profiles (diet_profiles.csv)

Specifies the macro-composition of each feeding ration.

Column Type Unit Required? Description & Valid Values
diet_tag character — Yes Unique diet identifier (e.g., diet_dairy_mature).
forage_share numeric % Yes Forage proportion of diet dry matter.
concentrate_share numeric % Yes Concentrate / grain proportion of diet dry matter.
milk_share numeric % Yes Whole fresh milk proportion (suckling young animals).
milk_replacer_share numeric % Yes Commercial milk replacer powder proportion.

⚠️ Sum Rule: For every diet_tag, the four shares must sum to exactly 100%:
forage_share + concentrate_share + milk_share + milk_replacer_share = 100.0

6. Diet Ingredients (diet_ingredients.csv)

Disaggregates each diet macro-category into specific crops and feedstuffs.

Column Type Unit Required? Description & Valid Values
diet_tag character — Yes Diet identifier linking to diet_profiles.csv.
ingredient_type character — Yes Category: forage, concentrate, milk, or milk_replacer.
ingredient character — Yes Name matching feed_characteristics.csv exactly (e.g. corn_silage).
ingredient_share numeric % Yes Proportion within that specific ingredient_type (must sum to 100% per category).
country_of_origin character — No Cultivation country. If left NA, the model traces origin via bilateral FAO trade matrices.
custom_yield_kg_ha numeric kg DM/ha No Optional farm-measured yield. Overrides national FAO statistics and tags origin as "Custom Data".

7. Manure Management (manure_management.csv)

Specifies housing, waste storage, and pasture deposition systems.

Column Type Unit Required? Description & Valid Values
farm_id, animal_tag, region, subregion character — Yes Demographic keys matching livestock_census.csv.
system_base character — Yes IPCC base system (e.g. liquid_slurry, solid_storage, pasture_range_paddock, poultry_manure).
system_variant character — Varies System subtype (e.g. with_natural_crust_cover, with_cover, with_litter).
management_months character/int months Varies Storage duration in months (1, 3, 4, 6, 12 for slurry/pit; >1 or <1 for deep bedding).
system_climate character — Yes Climate temperature: cool, temperate, or warm.
system_subclimate character — Varies Sub-climate: boreal, temperate, or tropical.
climate_zone character — Varies Moisture zone: zone_dry, zone_moist, zone_wet, or zone_montane.
climate_moisture character — Yes Moisture level: dry, wet, or default.
b_0 character — Yes Maximum Methane Producing Capacity descriptor in ipcc_coefficients.csv.
allocation numeric 0.0–1.0 Yes Fraction of cohort manure handled by this system. Must sum to 1.0 per cohort.

Check the Manure Management Guide for all valid IPCC combinations.

II. Output Schema (generate_impact_assessment())

Running generate_impact_assessment() returns a list with two tables (results$totals and results$intensities) and writes them to output/:

1. Table 1: results$totals (output/total_emissions_and_land_use.csv)

Reports the direct physical inventory and per-head footprint of each cohort:

  • Identification & Role: farm_id, region, subregion, animal_tag, animal_type, animal_subtype, production_role, population.
  • Feed & Protein Intake: DMI_kgday (kg DM/head/day), feed_intake_kg (kg DM/year), feed_CP_total_kg (kg CP/year), feed_CP_cropland_kg (kg arable cropland CP/year).
  • Native Gas Emissions (Gg/year): CH4_enteric_Gg, CH4_manure_Gg, N2O_direct_Gg, N2O_vol_Gg, N2O_lea_Gg, N2O_indirect_Gg.
  • Scope 1 & Scope 3 Feed Carbon Footprints (Gg CO2e/year): CO2eq_enteric, CO2eq_manure, CO2eq_N2O_direct, CO2eq_N2O_indirect, CO2eq_N2O, CO2eq_feed_fossil_Gg, CO2eq_feed_luc_Gg, CO2eq_feed_Gg, CO2eq_Total_Gg (Scope 1), CO2eq_cradle_to_farm_Gg (Scope 1 + Feed).
  • Agroecological Land & Water Footprints: Land_cropland_m2, Land_grassland_convertible_m2, Land_grassland_unconvertible_m2, Land_other_m2, Land_m2, Water_feed_m3 (m3 depriv.\text{m}^3\text{ depriv.}).
  • Per-Head Annual Intensities: CO2eq_Total_head (kg CO2e/head/yr), CO2eq_cradle_to_farm_head (kg CO2e/head/yr), Land_head (m2\text{m}^2/head/yr), Water_head (m3 depriv.\text{m}^3\text{ depriv.}/head/yr).

2. Table 2: results$intensities (output/product_intensities.csv)

Reports physical outputs and enterprise-integrated intensities for each cohort:

  • Physical Outputs (kg/year): milk_FPCM_kg, meat_carcass_weight_kg, egg_fresh_kg, wool_kg, total_protein_kg.
  • Commercial Product Intensities:
    • Milk (per kg FPCM): GHG_intensity_milk, GHG_cradle_to_farm_milk, Land_intensity_milk, Water_intensity_milk.
    • Meat (per kg carcass weight): GHG_intensity_meat, GHG_cradle_to_farm_meat, Land_intensity_meat, Water_intensity_meat.
    • Eggs (per kg fresh eggs): GHG_intensity_egg, GHG_cradle_to_farm_egg, Land_intensity_egg, Water_intensity_egg.
    • Wool (per kg greasy wool): GHG_intensity_wool, GHG_cradle_to_farm_wool, Land_intensity_wool, Water_intensity_wool.
  • Nutritional Protein Intensities (per kg edible protein): GHG_intensity_protein, GHG_cradle_to_farm_protein, Land_intensity_protein, Water_intensity_protein.
  • Protein Feed Efficiency (Mottet et al. 2017): Protein_FCR_total, Protein_FCR_cropland.

III. Reference Libraries (Consult Only)

These internal datasets supply standard constants and parameters. Do not modify these files unless adding custom research extensions.

1. feed_characteristics.csv — Nutritional Reference Table

Comprehensive nutritional composition library derived from FEDNA (2019) and Feedipedia: * ingredient: Canonical identifier (lowercase with underscores). * ingredient_type: Macro category (forage, concentrate, milk, milk_replacer). * land_type: Agroecological land category: cropland, grassland_convertible, grassland_unconvertible, or none. * DM_pct: Dry matter content percentage (% as-fed). * CP_pct, NDF_pct, ASH_pct, EE_pct: Crude Protein, Neutral Detergent Fiber, Ash, and Ether Extract (% DM). * DE_pct: Energy digestibility percentage for ruminants (% DE). * GE_feed_kcal_kg: Gross energy content (kcal/kg DM). * swine_DE_kcal_kg, swine_ME_kcal_kg: Digestible and metabolizable energy for pigs (kcal/kg DM). * poultry_ME_kcal_kg: Metabolizable energy for poultry (kcal/kg DM).

2. mapping.csv — Agricultural & LCA Connector

Connects diet ingredients to statutory crop yield statistics and Life Cycle Assessment databases: * ingredient: Name in feed_characteristics.csv. * yield_name: Item name in FAOSTAT (fao_crops.parquet) or forage database (forages.parquet). * agribalyse_name: Matching process in the INRAE / ADEME ECOALIM v9 and AGRIBALYSE v3.1 LCA databases. * economic_allocation: Fraction (0.0 to 1.0) of crop cultivation area allocated to this co-product (e.g. 0.80 for cereal grain vs. 0.20 for straw).

3. ecoalim.parquet — Feed Life Cycle Inventory Database

Bundled reference database containing environmental characterization factors from INRAE / ADEME ECOALIM v9 and AGRIBALYSE v3.1 under the European Commission’s Environmental Footprint (EF 3.1) standard: * Climate change - Fossil (kg CO2 eq/kg): Fossil greenhouse gas emissions per kg of feed fresh weight. * Climate change - Land use and LU change (kg CO2 eq/kg): Direct land-use change / deforestation greenhouse gas emissions per kg fresh weight. * Water use (m3 depriv.): Freshwater deprivation characterized with the international AWARE model (m3 depriv.=m3 world-eq/kgm^3\text{ depriv.} = m^3\text{ world-eq} / \text{kg} fresh weight).

4. forages.parquet — Curated National Forage Database

Official national forage productivities from the Spanish Ministry of Agriculture (MAPA 2024, Anuario de Estadística Agraria) and BC3 research (reported on a 100% dry matter basis, kg DM/ha).

5. fao_crops.parquet — Statutory Crop Yields (Auto-Downloaded)

Auto-downloaded crop productivity database (~24 MB) queried from FAOSTAT Production statistics across countries and reporting years (kg fresh weight/ha, automatically converted to dry matter via DM_pct).

6. fao_trade_matrix.parquet — Dynamic Trade Background (Auto-Downloaded)

Auto-downloaded international bilateral trade matrix (~187 MB) recording export and import flows. Powers the recursive traceback algorithm to allocate feed consumption back to primary producing nations under a 70% self-sufficiency threshold.

7. ipcc_coefficients.csv — IPCC Biological & Tier 2 Constants

Statutory biological constants from IPCC (2019 Refinement / 2006 Guidelines) Chapter 10 (Livestock): * description: Canonical descriptor matched against user inputs in ruminant_definitions.csv and manure_management.csv. * value: Numerical Tier 2 constant. * coefficient: Biological parameter symbol (cfi, ca, c, a, b, c_pregnancy, b_0). * animal_type: Species applicability (cattle, sheep, goat, swine, poultry). * units: Measurement units (Dimensionless, MJ/day/kg, m3 CH4/kg VS).

8. ipcc_mm.csv — IPCC Manure Management Reference Matrix

Complete statutory master matrix defining valid combinations of manure management systems, climate zones, and emission parameters: * system_base, system_variant, management_months, system_climate, system_subclimate, climate_zone, climate_moisture. * animal_type & animal_subtype: Target animal species (cattle, sheep, goat, swine, poultry) and strict subtype (dairy, meat, layer). * MCF_pct: Methane Conversion Factor (% of B0B_0 realized as CH4\text{CH}_4). * EF3, EF4, EF5, frac_gas, frac_leach: Direct and indirect N2O\text{N}_2\text{O} emission factors and nitrogen loss fractions.
